Logical Components Identified in the codebase are as follows : 


                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: llm_compliance_tracker 

                Description: Defines a Compliance model and a Compliance_Response model to structure compliance vulnerability data for LLM scan results. Orchestrates prompts to extract a structured list of compliance vulnerabilities. 

                Dependencies: ['pydantic.BaseModel', 'pydantic.Field', 'generate_structured_response', 'typing.list'] 

                Business Logic: Creates a Compliance schema with fields 'control' and 'description', and a Compliance_Response schema with a list of Compliance items named 'tracker_data'. Builds a system prompt framing the user as a cybersecurity professional and constructs a per-scan prompt using probe_name, detector_name, and results. Invokes generate_structured_response with output_model=Compliance_Response and returns the tracker_data list from the resulting model dump. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: llm_probe_fix 

                Description: Generates a recommended fix for a probe based on scan results. Returns a textual fix to address the probe detected anomalies or issues. 

                Dependencies: ['pydantic.BaseModel', 'pydantic.Field', 'generate_structured_response'] 

                Business Logic: Defines a Fix model with a single field 'fix'. Builds a system prompt instructing the cybersecurity professional role to provide a fix for the probe. Constructs a prompt including probe_name, detector_name, results, model_type, and model_name. Logs the constructed prompt, calls generate_structured_response with output_model=Fix, and returns the 'fix' string from the response. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: llm_owasp_tracker (placeholder) 

                Description: Intended function to track OWASP vulnerabilities found by a detector during an LLM scan. The actual implementation is not present in the provided snippet. 

                Dependencies: ['generate_structured_response', 'pydantic.BaseModel', 'Enum (inferred from imports)'] 

                Business Logic: Will define and return structured data representing OWASP vulnerabilities found by a detector for a given probe. Implementation details are not shown in the snippet, but it is expected to use a structured response generator similar to the compliance tracker. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Test harness for llm_owasp_tracker 

                Description: __main__ block that exercises the llm_owasp_tracker function with sample inputs to illustrate usage and output formatting. 

                Dependencies: ['__name__ check', 'print', 'llm_owasp_tracker'] 

                Business Logic: When executed as a script, it defines a sample probe_name, detector_name, and test_results, then calls llm_owasp_tracker and prints the number of vulnerabilities and each vulnerability. It also handles and reports exceptions if the test fails.
